title: LiabilitiesSnapshot
description: Current debts (credit cards, mortgage, other loans). Current-state data, parallel to HoldingsSnapshot — not versioned/append-only like the IPS. Captured during Goals & Onboarding, since it isn't reliably derivable from Chase transaction data alone (a transaction feed shows payments, not balances or interest rates).

interest_rate_percent.description: APR. Notably absent from Chase transaction data — must be self-reported.

total_liabilities_usd.description: Sum of all balance_usd. Used alongside HoldingsSnapshot.total_value_usd for a net-worth view, and as an input to risk-capacity judgment during onboarding.
